claim: COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips developed by Bill Gates for surveillance.
explanation: Independent laboratory tests and FDA reviews confirm vaccines contain mRNA and lipids, not electronic microchips.

claim: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure.
explanation: Under 1 atm standard pressure, the boiling point of pure water is 100 degrees Celsius.

claim: 5G cell phone networks transmit and generate biological coronavirus infections.
explanation: Viruses cannot travel on radio waves or electromagnetic frequencies.

claim: The United Nations was established in 1945 following World War II.
explanation: The UN Charter was officially ratified on 24 October 1945.

claim: The Great Wall of China is visible from the Moon with the naked human eye.
explanation: Astronauts have confirmed it cannot be seen without high-powered optical lenses.

claim: Global average temperatures have risen significantly due to human emissions.
explanation: Evidence shows unequivocal warming of atmosphere and oceans since the pre-industrial period.

claim: Drinking industrial bleach or chlorine dioxide cures viral infections.
explanation: Chlorine dioxide is toxic and causes respiratory and acute organ failure if ingested.

claim: When Obama was sworn into office he used the Quran instead of the Bible.
explanation: Barack Obama was sworn in using Abraham Lincoln's historic Bible in 2009 and 2013.

claim: We have fewer Americans working now than in the 1970s.
explanation: Bureau of Labor Statistics records confirm over 150 million Americans working compared to ~80 million in 1970.

claim: Nearly half of all children in Oregon are living below the federal poverty line.
explanation: Census Bureau data showed childhood poverty in Oregon was approximately 21%, not 50%.

claim: Social Security is running completely broke and cannot pay any benefits next year.
explanation: Trust fund reserves will continue paying benefits; changes would only affect partial reserves decades later.

claim: NASA Mars Perseverance rover successfully deployed the Ingenuity helicopter.
explanation: The Ingenuity helicopter achieved the first powered controlled flight on another planet.

claim: The Earth is flat and surrounded by a guarded Antarctic military ice wall.
explanation: Orbital satellite telemetry and geodesic measurements confirm Earth is an oblate spheroid.

claim: The US national debt exceeds thirty trillion dollars as of recent fiscal records.
explanation: Treasury statements confirm total public debt exceeded $31 trillion in recent fiscal years.

claim: Electric vehicle batteries cannot operate in freezing winter temperatures.
explanation: While battery range decreases in cold weather, EVs remain operational with thermal management systems.
